short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * np.maximum(ep_trial - 75, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * np.maximum(ep_trial-75,0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * (tv('reward',-2)==0)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: Silent at GO and D2. At D1 it fires (~2) only late in the episode, after the previous trial reached S2 and was unrewarded; strongest after common a2->S2 unrewarded, about half as strong after rare a1->S2 unrewarded; S1-unrewarded or any rewarded trial gives ~0. Magnitude ramps with episode trial (steps at ~80, 85, 90, 95). The free fit adds a boost when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row); belief log-odds and the earlier state add nothing. No future variables used.

issues: The 'trial >= 85' threshold in the label is too late. Activity rises steadily from about trial 75. The misses show D1 activations of 1.5 to 2.5 at t77-t83 after S2-unrewarded trials, where the short form predicts about 0. A linear ramp max(ep_trial-75,0) times last_is('a2 S2 u') / ('a1 S2 u') reaches test R^2 0.558 with 2 terms, against 0.523 for the recorded 3-term step form. Ramp start points of 70, 78 and 80 give 0.556, 0.548 and 0.535, so 75 is the best start.

The claim that rare a1->S2 unrewarded is 'roughly half as strong' is off. In the ramp fit the weights are 0.0215 vs 0.071, about 30%. In a step fit, a1S2u at >=85 gets 0.36 against a cumulative 0.77+0.37+0.43 for a2S2u late, about 25-45% depending on trial.
The two-losses-in-a-row boost is real and fits in short form. Adding (phase==D1)*last_is('a2 S2 u')*(tv('reward',-2)==0) raises test R^2 to 0.576 (dev 0.563). The label omits it.

Claims that check out: silent at GO/D2. Specific to the previous trial reaching S2 unrewarded (D1 residual after a1S1u or a2S1u is about -0.04, after a2S2u +0.27, after a1S2u +0.06). Belief adds nothing (an |belief_lo| interaction term gives +0.001).

Remaining error: firing looks closer to all-or-none (about 2.0-2.5 when on) with an on-probability that grows with episode trial. Linear terms therefore under-predict large early-late firings (e.g. actual 2.45 vs predicted 0.70 at t83), and about 40% of the variance is left. The misses tool also shows a small uniform over-prediction (about -0.03) at D1 after all other previous-trial types, from the timing baseline absorbing the late-episode mean.
